name: Cardiac Emergency
message: You are experiencing symptoms that may indicate a cardiac emergency (heart attack). These symptoms include chest pain, pressure, or shortness of breath.
action: Call emergency services (911) immediately or go to the nearest emergency room.

name: Stroke Warning Signs
message: You may be experiencing warning signs of a stroke. Symptoms include sudden numbness, confusion, trouble speaking, or severe headache.
action: Call emergency services (911) immediately. Time is critical for stroke treatment.

name: Severe Allergic Reaction (Anaphylaxis)
message: You may be experiencing a severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis) with symptoms like difficulty breathing, swelling, or throat tightness.
action: Use epinephrine auto-injector if available and call emergency services (911) immediately.

name: Severe Infection Warning
message: You are showing signs of a potentially severe infection that requires immediate medical evaluation.
action: Seek immediate medical care at an urgent care center or emergency room.

name: Possible Appendicitis
message: Your symptoms may indicate appendicitis, especially if you have severe pain in the lower right abdomen.
action: Seek immediate medical evaluation. Do not eat or drink anything until evaluated by a doctor.

name: Severe Dehydration
message: You may be severely dehydrated, which can be dangerous if not treated promptly.
action: Seek medical care immediately. Drink small amounts of water or electrolyte solution if able.

name: Possible Meningitis
message: Your symptoms may indicate meningitis, a serious infection of the brain and spinal cord membranes.
action: Seek emergency medical care immediately. This is a medical emergency.

name: Diabetic Emergency
message: If you have diabetes, these symptoms may indicate a diabetic emergency (very high or low blood sugar).
action: Check blood sugar if possible. Seek immediate medical care or call emergency services.

name: Possible Internal Bleeding
message: You may have internal bleeding, indicated by blood in vomit or stool, or black tarry stools.
action: Call emergency services (911) immediately or go to the emergency room.

name: Severe Asthma Attack
message: You may be experiencing a severe asthma attack that requires immediate treatment.
action: Use rescue inhaler if available. If symptoms don't improve quickly, call emergency services (911).

name: Pregnancy Complications
message: If you are pregnant, these symptoms may indicate serious complications requiring immediate medical attention.
action: Contact your obstetrician immediately or go to the emergency room.

name: Possible Blood Clot
message: You may have a blood clot (deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism), especially with leg swelling and pain or chest symptoms.
action: Seek immediate medical evaluation. Do not massage the affected area.
